note: Phase 6 CHANGE TUTORIALS (owner's D2 pick): every major change ships a walkthrough here; the beat nags when a dashboard build has none. Newest first on the cockpit's Direction card.

tutorials.title: M3 slice 1 — the console, the Rooms showpiece, the design system

interactive.try: The cockpit now opens with 'HOW CAN EXCAVA HELP?' — type a task, pick a department (or auto-route), 🎙 speak it, ＋ attach context, or tap a /trigger chip (NOSG/HORSE/PLAN/RESEARCH/WATCH). Enter dispatches.

The new 🗣 Rooms tab — the showpiece: real agent conversations as a messenger. War rooms get the red round-table frame; every bubble shows agent · engine · ms; 👔 leads sit raised. Pick rooms from the rail; days divide the scroll.
'While you were away' under the console = the last real beat actions (P13's digest, first form).

steps: Console hero (M3.10 part 1): full bar — dept selector, mic (browser speech-to-text), attach, slash-triggers parsed to P6 trigger words; dispatches at owner rank via the issue channel.
Rooms tab (M3.5): messenger UI over data/excava/chats day archives — bubbles with agent·engine·ms badges, suited leads raised, war-room round-table styling, room rail, artifact line.
App shell (M3.1 part 1): left sidebar on wide screens; design tokens (M3.0) live in docs/design/tokens.css — yellow+warm-ink, metal frames, greenery, organic shapes, industrial type.
Recovered + hardened: a UTF-8 corruption from a careless build-bump was caught and fixed from git history; build bumps now go through UTF-8-safe tooling only.

tutorials.title: M2 — real agents: named cast, live conversations, artifacts

interactive.try: The beat log now shows rooms advancing: named agents (Echo, Marrow, Ledger, Bastion, Nova…) speak via real free engines each CI beat — watch for 'X spoke (engine, ms)'.
Fleet health now reflects 38 named agents across 11 departments — leads wear suits, checkers push back by design (debate → converge).
Send a task: it becomes a WAR ROOM — doer proposes, checker challenges, lead states 'DECISION:' and a real artifact (package / bus task / labeled creation) is committed.

steps: 38 NAMED agents staff the 11 departments (roster: python -m src.excava_agents --roster): suited leads with personas that match the department AND change behavior; doers; skeptic checkers; improvers.

Conversations are the work mechanism (src/excava_chat.py): dept/cross/group/WAR rooms, real engine calls per message (agent · engine badge is truth), archived by day under data/excava/chats/, replayable.

Engines (M2.1): 9 free families first-class + optional self-hosted Hermes + optional OmniRoute gateway + Claude premium on your Pro (tight daily cap). Lease arbiter (M2.2): per-dept daily budgets, per-engine RPM, zero runaway.
Rooms produce ARTIFACTS on convergence: packages (data/packages.json), bus tasks, or G-12-labeled creations — transcript is proof, artifact is the point.
Self-improvement is real (M2.8): auto-tunes budgets, retires silent rooms, logs to improvements.jsonl — and files a PITCH for anything overhaul-class (P5: only 3 things wait for you).
PROTOCOLS.md (P1-P14) is law: the beat self-audits it every cycle; removing a protocol trips SAFE mode (proven in test).

tutorials.title: M1 — real, verified elements you can actually use

interactive.try: Open the Tools tab — every card now wears a verification badge: ✓ verified (2+ sources + live test), ◆ niche-verified (kept forever), unverified (never shown as real), ✗ dead (hidden).
On any card: ⚡ Activate copies a ready recipe · 🥞/🟢 Open jumps into the code (<10s; green = pre-warmed, instant) · 🦾 Use for a task sends it to EXCAVA · ▶ Video plays the real source.
Click 🔍 Detail on any card: the full element — embedded source-video bundle, related elements (really shown together), enrichment evidence, install line.

Three new 24/7 lanes: hourly discovery (GitHub/HN/ProductHunt/social — new tools land same-day), deep-retrieve (rebuilds thin items from FULL transcripts+READMEs), and the rolling verifier (2-source standard, conflicts noted).

steps: All 6,422 hub items are now ONE element model with verification: ✓ needs 2+ independent sources AND a live link test; below the bar = 'unverified', never shown as real; dead = hidden only after 2 consecutive full failures; niche kept forever (your P3 law).
Every card on Skills/Tools/Models/Prompts/Connectors/Designs has the action row: Activate / Open (<10s, pre-warmed instant) / Use-for-a-task / Video / Source / Detail.
The 🔍 Detail view (#element/<id>) shows the source-video bundle, 3-8 truly-related elements, enrichment evidence and trust.
CORE SPOT-ON lanes run 24/7: hourly discovery agent (same-day new tools), 2-hourly deep-retrieve (stub-rate → 0), 6-hourly verify+relate+prewarm (rolling weekly full pass).

tutorials.title: Creators live + connectors verification + your Direction card
steps: Cockpit → 🦾 Created by EXCAVA card: everything the Creators department made — each item is labeled, self-tested, and re-tested independently before its first use. 'Packages' = your term for multi-element bundles.
Connectors tab: a progress line now shows sandbox verification (your 'test-run everything' decision) marching through all 1,142 in CI batches; the tab shrinks to verified-only as results land (D5).

Cockpit → 🧭 Direction & tutorials card: state direction with the box (opens a prefilled 'EXCAVA: direction …' issue); EXCAVA's reading of each direction appears under it next beat — correct it by re-stating. This walkthrough list lives there too.
New goal G9 Agency/Orchestration on the North Star: scores how truly agentic the OS is (bus depth, hand-offs, autonomy under the gate).

tutorials.title: The living OS: fleet health, trace viewer, daemon feed
steps: Cockpit → 🛠 Fleet health: all 11 departments with their real workers, counters, and who's resting under backpressure.
Cockpit → 🚌 Live bus queue: click any task to open its REAL trace — including why a department was chosen over the runners-up.
Cockpit → 📡 OS events: the daemon feed — every pipeline lane's runs now become OS events, so EXCAVA sees the whole machine.
Floor bots are now real registered agents carrying their actual bus tasks (hover one). Safe/kill mode drops a maintenance overlay on the floor.

tutorials.title: You drive it: send box, kill switch, approval queue
steps: Cockpit → 🕹 You drive it: type a task, hit send — it opens a prefilled GitHub issue; CI queues it at owner rank and replies a receipt (works from your phone).
Same card: 🔴 kill / 🟡 safe / 🟢 run switches, and the priority-weights dial ('EXCAVA: weight access 95').
Cockpit → 🖊 Approval queue: the ONLY things waiting on you, each with a one-click approve link.

tutorials.title: Heavy Machinery cockpit + the OS spine underneath
steps: The cockpit became the home tab: living floor, task inbox, North-Star bars.
Underneath, Phase 0 built the file bus: departments pass work with validated hand-off docs; everything is traced in data/excava/.
